plans.idea: Product-left banner: a large bottle anchors the left third and a left-aligned column on the right stacks brand badge, a big one-line headline, then the CTA, all on one shared left edge.
Centered message: headline and CTA share a centered axis in the middle, with the bottle on the right and the brand badge on the left as matching bookends.
Left-to-right story strip: badge and headline open on the left, the bottle takes the center stage, and the CTA closes the read on the right at the vertical middle.
